Reference / csv/stream

csv/stream#

Explicit synchronous record consumption, default comma/quote/CRLF grammar.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

for await CsvStream(origin: upload) -> row {
    row[0];
}

Description#

Explicit synchronous record consumption, default comma/quote/CRLF grammar. One current row + at most 4099 undecoded bytes; no retained earlier rows. Borrowed Reading; close clears parser state, never closes origin. Calls must be serialized by the caller. EOF, syntax/UTF8/limit failure are stable until close; source failures propagate and the stream is closed (cannot resume). Earlier rows can escape before later corruption; validate EOF before commit.

An AsyncReading, an upload or a socket, is read with for await (#204):

next() answers none at the end of the rows; row() on such a stream is AsyncCsvOrigin.walked.
